english.title: Incorrect use of waterbath stunner to stun poultry at premises other than slaughterhouse
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) at premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..),

(A)_[used,]_
(B)_[caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use,]_
(C)_[permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use,]_

a waterbath stunner to stun poultry when

(D)_[the level of the water in the waterbath had not been adjusted in order to ensure that there was good contact with each bird's head]_
(E)_[the strength and duration of the current used was not such that the poultry were immediately rendered unconscious and remained so until dead]_
(F)_[a sufficient voltage, to produce a current strong enough to ensure that every bird in a group was stunned, was not maintained]_
(G)_[appropriate measures were not taken to ensure that the current passed efficiently]_
(H)_[it was not adequate in size and depth for the type of poultry being stunned]_
(I)_[it overflowed at the entrance]_
(J)_[measures were not taken, when an overflow was unavoidable, to ensure that no poultry received an electric shock before they were stunned]_
(K)_[the electrode which was immersed in the water did not extend the length of the waterbath]_
(L)_[a person was not available to ascertain whether the waterbath stunner had been effective in stunning the poultry and, if it had not been effective, would either stun or kill the poultry without delay]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 38 of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
at premises, other than a slaughterhouse for the killing of animals
used OR caused OR permitted a person to use
a waterbath stunner to stun poultry when
the level of the water in the waterbath had not been adjusted in order to ensure that there was good contact with each bird's head OR
the strength and duration of the current used was not such that the poultry were immediately rendered unconscious and remained so until dead OR
a voltage sufficient to produce a current strong enough to ensure that every bird is stunned was not maintained where poultry were stunned in groups in a waterbath OR
appropriate measures were not taken to ensure that the current passed efficiently OR
the waterbath stunner was not adequate in size and depth for the type of poultry being stunned OR
the waterbath stunner overflowed at the entrance OR
measures were not taken, when an overflow was unavoidable, to ensure that no poultry received an electric shock before they were stunned OR
the electrode which was immersed in the water did not extend the length of the waterbath OR
a person was not available to ascertain whether the waterbath stunner had been effective in stunning the poultry and, if it had not been effective, would either stun or kill the poultry without delay

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
